chats.title: Fix OverLit privacy and deletion safety
chats.scope:
Your app repo is /Users/alekj/Documents/GitHub/OverLit-app. Focus on OL-1/OL-2 in the follow-up plan and read overlit-recheck-fixes-2026-10-03.md. This task needs particularly careful reasoning and independent verification.

Concurrency: an active feature chat, “Assess chained-cell mechanic” (01a0ff00-4a04-7191-bd57-fcf1159ab963), is implementing chains/progression, tutorial/sounds and leaderboard versioning for staggered iOS/Android releases. It has been notified. Inspect its current progress read-only and establish file ownership before overlapping edits. Its leaderboard worker can overlap firebase/functions/src/api/submitRun.ts and rating/profile paths. Do not alter level catalogs, star calibration, chain mechanics or progression. Continue independent deletion/ads work while shared-file edits are coordinated.

Implement a durable per-identity deletion barrier established before cleanup. Every per-user writer must enforce it transactionally with its write: submission transactions and ledger completion, nickname creation/reroll/fan-out, rate counters, rating updates/refreshes and nontransactional fallback paths. Checking only at handler entry is insufficient; Admin SDK writers bypass client rules. Cleanup must be resumable/idempotent, handle Auth deletion failures and late responses, and not recreate an identity. Keep minimal protected suppression data; document purpose, fields and retention without assuming hashes are anonymous or choosing an arbitrary expiry that reopens replay. Cover old clients, queued requests, token lifetime, delayed jobs and restored backups.

Add deterministic race/retry tests around every writer and interruption/resumption, and prove other players remain unaffected. Coordinate with new leaderboard versioning so both safeguards hold.

Preserve the remediation baseline: Analytics build-deactivated, Tenjin inactive and Apple postback-copy endpoint removed, Crashlytics unlinked; AdMob remains. Verify both platform release artifacts and network/age/refusal/relaunch/privacy-options/cache behavior. Inspect live UMP/mediation/integrations/store forms where access allows; record older-build exposure separately.

Review Korea and India specifically using current official primary sources and actual code for ages 13, 14, 15, 16, 17 and unknown/changed region. Owner asks to treat existing setup as the baseline, but not to assume correctness without evidence. Identify a definite incompatible country requirement only with exact applicable provision, effective date, affected flow and code/config evidence. Separate child privacy, ad treatment, game age/content rating and conditional gaming registration/grievance duties. Do not remove availability or impose blanket parental consent from a guessed future commencement date. China status is unverified. The coordinating chat is running an independent GPT-6 Astra read-only review of this regional/deletion scope and can relay findings.

Leave a concise implementation/handoff report under Docs or the repo's established report directory, including needed app-specific public policy/deletion/store updates and canonical legal version changes. Do not edit shared website metadata concurrently.
chats.prompt:
Please carry out the app-level privacy/legal remediation assigned below, verifying the current code and implementing confirmed local fixes. The owner asked for a separate chat per app and asked the agents to keep working while they are away. This is implementation work, not just another plan or wording audit.

Owner-confirmed facts as of 4 October 2026: the operator is a sole trader based in Poland, publishing personally. All apps/platforms are live except Voice of Self Android; Voice's live iOS release is the older Swift implementation, not the new KMP app. Live releases are intended for ages 13 and above. AudioChoices is intended for 13+, and its finer age/content filters are additional safeguards, not a declaration that it targets under-13s. AudioChoices is not offered in China; Voice is believed available worldwide. Other China exclusions and exact live version numbers are uncertain. OverLit is confirmed offered in South Korea and India. These are owner statements, not proof of store-console settings or actual known user ages.

Read the existing repo AGENTS.md and relevant legal-sync skill before implementation. The canonical website/legal repo is /Users/alekj/Documents/GitHub/alekjaltuszyk-website. Read its docs/legal/recheck-2026-10-03.md (including the follow-up implementation plan), skills/legal-update-sync/CHANGE-REVIEW.md and CHECKLIST.md, plus the relevant implementation report beside the recheck. The October 3 audit and patches are a starting point, not evidence of production configuration. Inspect current symbols and the final diff. Recheck current primary legal/vendor sources where needed; preserve distinctions between confirmed mismatch, unknown production setting, prospective duty and legal judgment.

You are not alone in these working trees. Preserve other agents' edits and existing legal/consent patches; do not reset, stash, broadly stage, overwrite an entire shared file from a stale snapshot or change branches underneath someone. Work in this existing checkout. Your ownership is your app repository and its app-specific remediation evidence. The website coordinating chat owns shared website metadata, legal version authoring and final public synchronization; avoid concurrent edits there. Record exact proposed website text/version changes in a handoff in your own repo, and report any needed synchronization as unresolved until it is applied. Do not call the change release-ready with stale public copy.

Complete authorized local fixes, meaningful regression tests and relevant builds. Read-only production/store/provider inspection using already available access is allowed; do not print credentials or publish account identifiers, user payloads or support records. No deployment, store submission, irreversible historical data cleanup, destruction of migration originals or paid entitlement removal is requested by this assignment. Prepare such operations concretely and record required evidence/actions. Do not keep asking for permission for the already authorized local work.

Record before/closing legal-impact receipts. Test refusal, withdrawal, relaunch, age changes, queued/stale work, retention/deletion, purchases and authorization as relevant. A hashed/pseudonymous ID is not automatically anonymous; ad eligibility/ATT is not optional analytics consent; an OS permission or Terms acknowledgement is not a blanket lawful basis. Do not claim global compliance, personal-asset protection or that new source code cured older processing. Age-rating/13+ framing cannot justify ignoring platform-known children or the app's actual audience. Preserve mandatory consumer rights.

Use only the existing approved simulator families (iOS 18.6/iPhone 16 class and the existing newest iOS/iPhone 17 class); do not download runtimes or create more devices. Avoid simultaneous builds with another agent in the same checkout. Keep fixes scoped and reviewable, with a report of changed files, actual passing checks, unverified production items and precise release blockers. The coordinating chat is 01a10279-03e6-7a63-ac59-4d65613cbae9; it will read your progress and collect handoffs.

chats.title: Fix AudioChoices age and data safety
chats.scope:
Your app repo is /Users/alekj/Documents/GitHub/AudioBookChoices. Implement AC-1/AC-2/AC-3 from the follow-up plan; read broad-recheck-fixes-2026-10-03.md.

AudioChoices is deliberately 13+. The existing finer age filtering for violence and other content is an additional safeguard; do not remove it, reclassify the intended audience as under-13 or build an unnecessary parental identity system from the mere existence of a filter. Verify content/marketing/actual or platform-known audience and current applicable rules. For the 13+ general-audience design, enforce reviewed processing eligibility before nonessential Firebase identity/RevenueCat/rating/reporting operations. Trace real startup/order rather than only the analytics switch. Handle unknown/delayed/lower platform age, manual conflicts, age changes and restored preferences without silently promoting users to adult. Operational exceptions need actual purpose-specific justification; known under-13 age cannot be ignored. Preserve access to paid entitlements and the identity that supports them. Audio delivery and infrastructure logs still require inventory even if optional features are withheld.

The staged remediation already build-deactivates Google measurement and separates story reporting with age/refusal/withdrawal guards; preserve and reverify it. Check current UI and the wider runtime path.

Close or carefully resolve the rating-during-erasure window documented in firebase/functions/src/deleteMyData.ts together with ratings.ts. A transactional erasure state/generation should reject stale affected writes and preserve legitimate later intentional actions; address older callable contracts. Do not suppress necessary purchase/refund webhooks or erase paid entitlements. Test index claim/restore failure, concurrent submit/remove/delete, stale response/retry and aggregate consistency.

Review retained Auth/purchase/free-unlock fields and actual justified retention. Check revenuecat.ts webhook IDs, deployed asynchronous TTL, older records/retired per-user milestones, logs/backups and restoration re-erasure. Prepare dry-run cleanup evidence only; do not delete live records.

Resolve the existing pinned RevenueCat vs Xcode compatibility build failures narrowly. Build the full iOS app and verify real consent/age UI, offline legal deferral, withdrawal and purchase restore using approved simulators. Recheck SDK startup/privacy after a dependency change. Prior Android 686-test pass and linked Kotlin framework do not prove full iOS behavior. Distinguish newly tested build from an existing installed emulator package.

Produce an app-owned implementation report and exact app-specific public policy/deletion/support/store/version handoff. Do not edit shared website configuration concurrently.

chats.title: Fix Voice of Self AI and deletion controls
chats.scope:
Your app repo is /Users/alekj/Documents/GitHub/closure-app. Implement VS-1 through VS-4 in the follow-up plan. Keep released Swift iOS behavior separate from prospective KMP iOS/Android; Voice Android is not live. The owner previously reported no users, but verify available release evidence. Existing “Review KMP UI parity” chat 01a10275-7388-74a2-823e-658fc2114126 may have relevant edits: inspect status and preserve them.

Add a genuine production managed-AI withdrawal action and persisted separate choice, not a renamed test-only clear helper. Cover Swift/KMP paths as applicable, Settings/legal UI, dispatch, automatic processing, live questions, retries/resumed jobs and stale replies. Withdrawal must stop new requests/queued work without blocking unrelated local journal access/export or paid recovery. Explain limitations for already forwarded requests. Test mid-request/offline withdrawal, relaunch, consent copy updates and reenabling. Review backend/background enforcement and older request contracts.

Verify each actual active managed provider route/fallback, accepted agreements and retention against earlier commitments. Current Bedrock transport uses Converse: inspect model, region, inference-profile cross-region routing, API applicability, provider retention and invocation logging independently. Groq organization ZDR/control evidence is separate. Do not assume a new retention setting for another API applies to Converse, or that store=false/disabled invocation logs proves all retention. Add appropriate route enforcement so an unverified route cannot be silently activated or used as fallback contrary to the notice; record missing production evidence rather than invent it.

Inventory retained plaintext legacy database/sidecars/audio *.migrated originals. Implement safe protection/recovery or a clear cleanup control where warranted, but do not destroy original user data. Prove imported encrypted records and audio, crash recovery and second launch correctness; migrated encrypted files share directory paths, so indiscriminate cleanup loses good audio. Check file protection/backups.

Identify released signed-in deletion/grace-period endpoints and the new support-ID rights route from deployed evidence. The old service is absent from current tracked backend. Purchase restore/new UID does not erase or prove ownership of old identity records. Prepare a workable minimized request/deletion process and synthetic verification; do not recreate identity to find records.

Public Privacy/Terms/AI canonical bodies are in the website repo's src/content/legal/; bundled copies are external/legal/. The canonical AI body already matches public/manifest/Swift/KMP fallbacks. Preserve parity and make a precise handoff for any changed practice/version/consent body before new features activate. Never certify prospective KMP controls as present in the older live Swift build.
